0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000010_TANSUI
0.description: Gentlemen! I am told you were most unreceptive to my associate's requests.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000020_TANSUI
1.description: I realize you do not look kindly on the Confederacy and her ways. But if you refuse to pay the Ruby Tithe, your safety in these waters cannot be assured.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000030_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
2.description: Spare me your concern, pirate.<hex:02100103>Your feeble attempts at extortion will not work on us.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000040_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
3.description: You remain at large because we allow it─because you are such insignificant little pests that we see no need to swat you.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000050_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
4.description: But if you wish to risk the ire of the viceroy, by all means, fire upon an imperial vessel. Give us a reason to bring the full might of the Garlean Empire to bear against your pathetic fleet.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000070_TANSUI
6.description: Gentlemen. Surely the fact that you have such limitless resources at your disposal gives you all the more reason to spare some few coins for the<hex:02100103>less fortunate?

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000080_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
7.description: All talk, just as I thought. Come─let us away. I have no time for this rubbish.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000090_LYSE
8.description: We're all the same to them, aren't we? Savages to be ruled or slaughtered.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000100_TANSUI
9.description: They've always balked at paying the Ruby Tithe.<hex:02100103>But they were never so eager to pick a fight...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000110_TANSUI
10.description: The problem, you see, is that many of my comrades in the Confederacy are of Doman descent─and the acting viceroy...well, she's none too fond of Domans, to say the least.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000120_TANSUI
11.description: If we take any action to hinder the safe passage of an imperial vessel, she'll accuse us of attempting to foment rebellion and brand us enemies of the Empire─which we can ill afford to be. Like the man said, we're all talk.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000130_ALISAIE
12.description: And where do the Kojin stand in all this?

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000140_TANSUI
13.description: With the winning side, of course. They are mercenaries to a fault, eager to offer their services without coercion.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000150_TANSUI
14.description: The shellback could tell you more...though something tells me he would rather not.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000160_LYSE
15.description: I don't understand. If the Garleans are causing the Confederacy this much trouble─and if so many of you are Doman to begin with─why aren't you willing to fight back?

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000170_TANSUI
16.description: Hahaha! Spoken like a true friend of the Doman Liberation Front.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000180_TANSUI
17.description: If you're planning to rouse us with noble words and grand promises─don't bother. We all know what the imperial army can do. Compared to them, we're boys with boats.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000190_TANSUI
18.description: Besides, what ties a man may once have held to his home are forsaken upon joining the Confederacy. We look out for none but our own.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000200_TANSUI
19.description: Be that as it may, our livelihood is under threat, and the captain will need to decide soon whether we are to go down in a blaze of glory or bow and scrape for crumbs from the Emperor's table.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000210_TANSUI
20.description: ...All while our friend the viceroy continues her purge of Doma's “radical elements.” I believe she's holding court in one of the fishing villages even<hex:02100103>as we speak.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000220_GOSETSU
21.description: That she-devil! Her perfidy knows no bounds!

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000230_GOSETSU
22.description: She must be stopped. Come, let us find Soroban and put to sea at once!

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000240_TANSUI
23.description: Tell the others that these ones have paid. We all have places to be.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000250_ALISAIE
24.description: Even accounting for the rebellion, such indiscriminate shows of force seem pointlessly excessive...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000260_GOSETSU
25.description: If only you knew how commonplace such scenes have become.<hex:02100103>Hmm... Are we too late?

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000280_GOSETSU
27.description: ...It is she! Sworn enemy of Doma─of my master! The traitor who sold her homeland to the Garleans─Yotsuyu!

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000290_LYSE
28.description: The viceroy herself. And look─behind her! Isn't that...?

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000300_YOTSUYU
29.description: Filth and squalor everywhere I look. How very Doman.<hex:02100103>What I wouldn't do for a drink...

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000310_YOTSUYU
30.description: Come now, you've no reason to look so afraid! You have lived through a quarter of a century of Garlean rule, remember?

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000320_YOTSUYU
31.description: 'Tis better to bend with the wind than stand tall and be broken.<hex:02100103>Therein lies...hope. Therein lies freedom.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000330_YOTSUYU
32.description: I come before you today seeking affirmation. A heartfelt declaration. You are free to answer me as you see fit─yet even the least among you should know the correct response. Should.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000340_YOTSUYU
33.description: A resident of your village─one of your neighbors, mayhap your friend─was detained by the Kojin this morning. They say he was attempting to flee to Kugane, but we both know that simply isn't true, don't we? Have you anything to say?

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000350_YOTSUYU
34.description: ...A bit slow, this one. Is there anyone more sensible among you? Have any of you anything to say? To swear?

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000360_E3F1VILLAGER
35.description: M-My lady, I...I swear to serve the Empire! To do...whatever is asked of me...and never disobey...

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000370_YOTSUYU
36.description: Well said that man. Of course...it wouldn't do to simply take you at your word.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000380_YOTSUYU
37.description: Kill him. Surely you can do that much? He must be guilty of something or other, or he wouldn't have attempted to flee the Empire.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000390_E3F1VILLAGER
38.description: I...I have a family... Kami forgive me... Kami forgive me...

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000400_YOTSUYU
39.description: Very, very good! I've always had a soft spot for men like you.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000410_YOTSUYU
40.description: Next, I want you to shoot those two over there. Too old to work, you understand─a burden on the Empire, and we can't have that.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000420_E3F1VILLAGER
41.description: But...they're my parents. You can't expect me to...

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000440_ALISAIE
46.description: Stop and think for a moment! If you go charging in now, every one of those villagers is as good as dead!

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000450_ALISAIE
47.description: <hex:020810E905FF065368652773FF054865277303> right. They would simply take the villagers hostage.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000460_ALISAIE
48.description: We must consider the wider picture. If we act recklessly, we risk alerting the Garleans to our presence here, making it that much harder for us to work with the local rebels─to say nothing of the reprisals ordinary civilians would be made to suffer.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000470_GOSETSU
49.description: Open your eyes, girl─they are already suffering! Let me go─I am putting an end to this madness!

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000480_GOSETSU
50.description: I will approach the village alone and identify myself. As a former leader of the rebellion and a known fugitive, they will wish to detain me until they are certain they have learned all I know. Use this time to make your plans!

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000490_LYSE
51.description: You saw what those monsters did to the villagers! Who knows what they'll do to you─assuming they don't kill you where you stand!

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000500_GOSETSU
52.description: We live and die at the pleasure of the kami. My fate is in their hands, and no other's. If it be of any comfort, I am no stranger to chains.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000510_LYSE
53.description: You can't expect us to stand idly by as a comrade goes marching off to his death! And this is nothing like Kugane!

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000520_ALISAIE
54.description: ...Nor is it like the Reach, Lyse─or the Wall. Let him go.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000530_ALISAIE
55.description: Hold out for as long as you can, but remember: noble sacrifices are to remain an absolute last resort. I wish I could say it won't come to that, but only the gods know how we're going to get you and the others out in one piece.<hex:02100103>A miracle, perchance...

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000540_GOSETSU
56.description: A great tower stands to the north and east. Look to its occupants for aid and succor. Together, you may yet find your miracle.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000550_GOSETSU
57.description: Now, leave this place. I must go.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000560_YOTSUYU
58.description: Tsk tsk... Another idiot like all the rest. I'm beginning to think it may be something fundamental, something intrinsic, something quintessentially Doman to ignore the simple truth: you can't do a damn thing if you're dead.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000590_GOSETSU
61.description: Hear me, Yotsuyu: cease this farce, here and now, and I shall surrender myself to you. Refuse, and all shall answer to my blade.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000610_TANSUI
63.description: Our most compassionate acquaintances return. For your deeds, we owe you many thanks.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000620_TANSUI
64.description: ...But something tells me our thanks are not sufficient. The strange thing is, I was certain you understood our position. And yet here you are with that same look in your eyes─and those same words upon your lips, I'll wager.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000630_ALISAIE
65.description: I speak only the truth. The Confederacy will not be spared Yotsuyu's wrath. You have always known this─that one day you would have no choice but to stand up to the Empire. I say to you that day is today, and come once more to ask that you join us in the fight.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000640_TANSUI
66.description: How convenient that recent events should lend such credence to your claims. Tell me, do death and destruction always follow in your wake?

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000650_RASHO
67.description: They had no part in it, Tansui. You know this. We all know this.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000660_RASHO
68.description: They came and took our Doman brothers. They will torture them for her sport─murder them for her satisfaction.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000670_RASHO
69.description: So we attack, and get butchered for our trouble...or do naught, and let them have their pound of flesh.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000680_RASHO
70.description: If this be our choice, I say we suffer the ignominy. We endure. We survive. There is no better path.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000690_RASHO
71.description: Until the day our enemy is grown weaker, and we stronger, there can be no retribution. We will wait for a sign. Such is the judgment of the Confederacy.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000700_LYSE
72.description: So that's it, then. You're just going to abandon them. To her.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000710_LYSE
73.description: They'd die for you, you know─for the Confederacy. They would die for you, but you wouldn't even think to risk your lives for theirs!

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000720_ALISAIE
74.description: I have one last idea, if you will allow. I'm afraid it's not very good as ideas go─it's exceedingly reckless, in fact, and you may well come to despise me for ever having suggested it. Assuming we survive, that is.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000730_ALISAIE
75.description: The question being: do you trust me?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
77.description: Do you even need to ask?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000740_LYSE
79.description: We can't stand by and let innocent people suffer─here or anywhere else.<hex:02100103>I'll do whatever it takes.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000750_ALISAIE
80.description: Then let us roll the dice.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000760_ALISAIE
81.description: If it's a sign you want, we shall give you one. One rousing enough to make you drive every Garlean out of Isari without a second thought.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000770_ALISAIE
82.description: You are wary of invoking the ire of the imperial forces stationed in Doma, correct?

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000780_ALISAIE
83.description: Know then that once we have rescued our comrade and freed Isari, we mean to liberate the nation as a whole.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000790_ALISAIE
84.description: You will doubtless require assurances that we are capable of achieving this─and that is only fair. Accordingly, we shall demonstrate our seriousness by depriving the Garleans of a key ally: the Kojin.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000800_TANSUI
85.description: What, the three of you? Just like that?

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000810_ALISAIE
86.description: Actually, my esteemed colleague here will attend to it on <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> own. But the how of it is not your concern─only the outcome.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000820_ALISAIE
87.description: If we succeed, you help us liberate Isari. If we fail, you lose nothing. A simple enough wager─if you have the stones for it.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000830_TANSUI
88.description: The little miss does make it hard to refuse, does she not?

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000840_RASHO
89.description: Words are air. We will weigh you by your deeds.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000850_ALISAIE
90.description: Is that light I see up ahead?

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000870_ALISAIE
92.description: We, uh...appear to be standing inside a giant bubble.<hex:02100103>By the Twelve...I think we're on the seabed!

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000880_SOROBAN
93.description: Well, well! I thought I heard familiar voices.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000890_LYSE
94.description: Soroban? What are you doing here?

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000900_SOROBAN
95.description: Hmm? What a curious question. I live here.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000910_LYSE
96.description: Then this is the home of the Blue Kojin?

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000920_SOROBAN
97.description: Just so. I bid you welcome to Tamamizu!

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000930_BUNCHIN
98.description: Welcome, guests. Gratitude to you for aiding Soroban in his negotiations.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000940_ALISAIE
99.description: We thank you for your hospitality, honored elder. Pray forgive me my brevity, but I wish to discuss an urgent matter...

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000950_BUNCHIN
100.description: So...you seek to compel our Red brothers to forgo hostilities for a time.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000960_LYSE
101.description: That's right. We know your two clans have your...differences, but what with you being...brothers and all, we thought you might be able to share some...secret knowledge...or something?

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000970_BUNCHIN
102.description: From far above, you have journeyed here in search of our wisdom.<hex:02100103>You shall have it.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000980_BUNCHIN
103.description: All creation is a tapestry, through which the divine is interwoven.<hex:02100103>Kami are legion, and they can be found in the great and the small.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_000990_BUNCHIN
104.description: Though they come and go as they please, they favor certain vessels.<hex:02100103>The ancient. The precious. The exquisite.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001000_BUNCHIN
105.description: We Kojin covet these vessels, these treasures. We go forth and bring them home, to keep them safe and bask in their divinity. They bring prosperity and joy to us and our children.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001010_BUNCHIN
106.description: Yet how were we to seek these treasures above if we made enemies of the Garlean Empire, powerful and far-reaching as they are?

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001020_BUNCHIN
107.description: Wiser to join with them. So resolved the Red Kojin.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001030_SOROBAN
108.description: Cautiously and carefully, for the Garleans are blind to the divine. Nor will they suffer their subjects to see.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001040_SOROBAN
109.description: So the Red masquerade as mercenaries who seek money and power and never speak of their faith in the presence of their masters.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001050_SOROBAN
110.description: To honor the divine, they deny it. A twisted and misguided path.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001060_BUNCHIN
111.description: Aye, aye. Kami will not abide such foolishness, this they shall learn to their sorrow.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001070_BUNCHIN
112.description: While our Red brothers live by the sword, we Blue Kojin uphold the old ways, engaging in trade and valuing peace.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001080_BUNCHIN
113.description: Alas, men distinguish not between our clans, and judgment for the doings of the Red falls unjustly upon the Blue. Thus do men grow more and more reluctant to deal with us, denying us our treasures. This cannot continue!

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001090_ALISAIE
114.description: On that point we are in agreement. You are willing to aid our cause, then?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001100_BUNCHIN
115.description: There is a way that the Red may be driven to retreat into their shells.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001110_BUNCHIN
116.description: But to share with you this knowledge is to reveal secrets of the divine. Assurances must first be had. Trust forged. A bargain struck.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001120_SOROBAN
117.description: Well said, Elder! In great crises is great profit to be had!

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001130_BUNCHIN
118.description: Delight not overmuch in such things, Soroban.<hex:02100103>Now, tell our guests what must be done.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001150_LYSE
120.description: Well, I've no idea what we've gotten ourselves into, but so far, so good, right?

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001160_SOROBAN
121.description: It is done. Your offerings have been given to the sea.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001170_SOROBAN
122.description: The ritual can begin at last. Come and stand before me, my friends.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001180_SOROBAN
123.description: Yes, yes. Listen to my words, and let all else wash away. Listen to my words, and feel them flow into your heart...at first a trickle, then a flood...

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001190_SOROBAN
124.description: O kami of the fathomless waters,<hex:02100103>Of the fallen, the ascended, the flowing, and the becalmed,<hex:02100103>Caretakers of the shallows and of the depths...

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001200_SOROBAN
125.description: Receive of us our meager offerings,<hex:02100103>Cleanse these ones of earth and stone, and grant them your blessing,<hex:02100103>That they might drink deep of the divine...

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001210_SOROBAN
126.description: The ritual is complete, my friends.<hex:02100103>You may now breathe in the depths as you would upon land.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001220_ALISAIE
127.description: Strange. I don't feel any different. Are you sure it worked?

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001230_SOROBAN
128.description: ...Reasonably. The blessing does have its limits, of course. While it will allow you to dwell in the depths, it will not help you traverse them.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001240_LYSE
129.description: I can swim well enough. How about you, Alisaie?

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001250_ALISAIE
130.description: Oh, like a fish. In contrast to my doggy-paddling brother.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001251_ALISAIE
131.description: Somehow, the boy just isn't very buoyant.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001260_SOROBAN
132.description: Hmm...skilled or no, your bodies are ill-suited to the sea.<hex:02100103>Your cause demands alacrity, and you shall have it.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001270_SOROBAN
133.description: But first, let us take to the water.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001280_ALISAIE
134.description: Incredible... I could swear I was breathing air!

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001290_SOROBAN
135.description: Now, I shall summon for you noble steeds of great strength.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001300_LYSE
136.description: Wow, look at them! I bet they could take us all the way to the deepest depths of the sea!

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001310_ALISAIE
137.description: And so they may─after we've won over the Confederacy, rescued Gosetsu, and liberated your respective homelands.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001311_SOROBAN
138.description: Should you become parted from your steeds, return to me, and I shall call them again. Take care, my friends, and may the kami speed you on your way.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001320_LYSE
139.description: We'll find that treasure in no time! Come on!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001329_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
140.description: Meanwhile, in the tavern of Isari...

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001350_YOTSUYU
143.description: I tire of this filthy tavern and its still filthier clientele.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001360_GOSETSU
144.description: 'Tis scant reward for your treachery, aye. A painted woman of your rich experience deserves a better class of customer.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001370_YOTSUYU
145.description: Name-calling? Is that what we've been reduced to?

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001380_GOSETSU
146.description: Orphan of the Naeuri, widow of Sashihai─what joy it must have brought you to be revenged upon us all.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001400_YOTSUYU
148.description: My appetite for your agony is as an abyss─bottomless. Insatiable.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001410_YOTSUYU
149.description: Before you die, you will cry and beg and prostrate yourself upon the earth. You will crawl on your belly through the muck and the piss, and debase yourself for my amusement. All of you.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001420_YOTSUYU
150.description: But you think you are made of sterner stuff. Hm. Rather than have him beat you, mayhap I should have my oaf go and fetch your master's head...?

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001430_YOTSUYU
151.description: Poor, poor Lord Kaien─kami rest his soul! Noble leader of a fallen nation...<hex:02100103>A fine puppet he made for the viceroy─for a time.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001440_YOTSUYU
152.description: Twenty-five years he was content to serve his masters as a dog. And then everyone had to rise up and get themselves killed.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001450_YOTSUYU
153.description: Tell me, how did it feel to fail him that day?<hex:02100103>To live with the disgrace of his death.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001460_YOTSUYU
154.description: Not that you were a stranger to living with disgrace, of course. In the, what was it, twenty-five years since you were humiliated and tossed into an imperial gaol, you had plenty of time to get used to it.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001470_YOTSUYU
155.description: Oh yes, I heard the stories. About the samurai who would do anything to return to his master's side─even if it meant pledging his blade to his sworn enemy. They say he walked with death─that he slew a thousand men in the Empire's name. Truly a tale for the poets.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001480_GOSETSU
156.description: I do not deny my sins. But I will not be reproached by the likes of you.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001490_YOTSUYU
157.description: Oh, I mean not to reproach you, but to praise you! You're a survivor, samurai. Just...like...me.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001500_YOTSUYU
158.description: So let us not dwell on the past, you and I, and instead give thought to the future. To wit, I would ask you again to help me resolve this vexing matter of Doma's missing heir.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001510_YOTSUYU
159.description: Living or dead, it makes no difference really─but the Garleans are most insistent that we put this problem behind us, and I know you helped him flee. So, tell me: what became of Lord Hien?

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001520_GOSETSU
160.description: To my dismay, the details escape me at present.<hex:02100103>Mayhap your dog could jog my memory?

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001530_YOTSUYU
161.description: Get on with it! And mark me, brute: there is no limit to how far you can fall.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001540_GRYNEWAHT
162.description: Of all the bloody... <mumble> <mumble> When I get back to Eorzea, I'm going to find that little shite and I'm gonna make <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> pay...

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001560_KOUJINTAICHO
164.description: Thieves! Thieves! Come to steal our most precious treasures!<hex:02100103>You will pay for this sacrilege!

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001570_LYSE
165.description: That's the spirit! Now don't be shy─I'm more than ready for another round!

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001610_KOUJINTAICHO
169.description: Hark! A great kami stirs... Yes, yes, a great kami of the sacred treasures!

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001620_KOUJINTAICHO
170.description: O great kami, we beseech your intercession! We who have guarded your blade and glass for generations─your faithful Kojin!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
172.description: It was I who made you whole.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
173.description: If I made you whole, it was not my intent. I but carried the trinket.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001630_SUSANO
174.description: (-???-)Thou didst freely deliver our jewel unto thine enemy's own treasure vault?

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001640_SUSANO
175.description: (-???-)Hah hah hah! How auspicious! We do commend thee, <hex:020812E905FF096461756768746572FF04736F6E03> of man.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001650_SUSANO
176.description: (-???-)Such audacity is deserving of celebration, exultation─a contest of wills to mark the occasion! Let lines be drawn! Let sides be chosen! And for their loyalty, we shall stand with the caretakers of our greater part.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001660_ALISAIE
177.description: Oh, perfect. A contest of wills. Just what we need.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001670_SUSANO
178.description: (-???-)Hahahaha hah hah hah! Hearken to us, shelled ones! Upon this day, your wish shall be granted!

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001680_SUSANO
179.description: (-???-)Curse neither your fate nor its executor, children of man, for we are of the divine─of both heaven and earth. The ringing silence. The raging calm.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001690_SUSANO
180.description: (-???-)All riseth and falleth at the whim of capricious fortune. Assume your marks upon the stage, and embrace the coming chaos!

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001700_SUSANO
181.description: (-Susano-)We are Susano, and in revelry do we rejoice!

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001710_LYSE
182.description: That...that's a primal standing in front of us, right?

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001720_ALISAIE
183.description: And a horde of angry Kojin at our backs.<hex:02100103><sigh> This contest is getting worse by the moment.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001730_ALISAIE
184.description: Lyse! Help me clear a path!

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001740_ALISAIE
185.description: Leave them to us and save your strength. You'll be needing it soon enough.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001760_SUSANO
187.description: (-Susano-)Spoil not your appetite for the feast, children of man. The dish will be served, whether you will it or no! Hah hah hah hah haaah!

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001769_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
188.description: Meanwhile, off the coast of Othard...

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001770_TANSUI
189.description: Nary a peep from the shellbacks, sir. It's enough to make one wonder...

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001780_SOROBAN
190.description: The Red have sounded the alarum. The Isle of Zekki under attack;<hex:02100103>fierce fighting in the stronghold.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001790_SOROBAN
191.description: The vault breached by outsiders, and strange tales from deep within.<hex:02100103>All this, the Red cannot ignore.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001800_SOROBAN
192.description: Even now, they abandon their posts and flock to the isle.<hex:02100103>The Garleans are powerless to stop them.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001810_TANSUI
193.description: I'll be damned. They did it.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001820_TANSUI
194.description: Well, Captain...wagers notwithstanding, I daresay we will not have a better opportunity to drive the imperials from Isari and rescue our men.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001830_TANSUI
195.description: On the other hand, naught was put in writing... But if your mind is made up, then that is that.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001840_TANSUI
196.description: ...I should add that if you were to change your mind, none would gainsay your decision, nor think you beholden to your past.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001850_TANSUI
197.description: Nor would anyone begrudge you a spot of revenge into the bargain.<hex:02100103>Like the little miss said, we knew this day would come.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001860_RASHO
198.description: Isari may be a rotting husk, but at least the tavern keeper never watered down his drinks.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001870_TANSUI
199.description: Well said for a temperate man.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001880_RASHO
200.description: Hear me, comrades! We made a bargain with the Eorzeans, and I mean to uphold our end of it. I mean to remind the Garleans that this is our sea─that all here belongs to the Confederacy!

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001890_RASHO
201.description: All that is theirs is ours for the taking─and take it we shall.<hex:02100103>We will strip them of everything they hold dear!

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001900_GRYNEWAHT
202.description: This one is iron. My hands will break before he speaks.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001910_YOTSUYU
203.description: Ugh, kami give me strength. Are you good at anything?

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001920_YOTSUYU
204.description: I had hoped this might prove more productive than blind inquiries, but I see you are determined to waste my time. Very well.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001930_YOTSUYU
205.description: Line them up. Kill one for every question he refuses to answer.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001940_GOSETSU
206.description: Hurt them, and you will get naught from me!

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001950_YOTSUYU
207.description: You have given me precisely that thus far, so what have I to lose? Mark me, samurai─I will find Lord Hien, be it with your help or with your heads.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001960_E3F1GARLEANSOLDIER
208.description: (-???-)Confederate scum! You will pay for─ Aaargh!

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001970_KIDNAPPEDPIRATE
209.description: The Confederacy! They've come to save us!

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001980_YOTSUYU
210.description: And this after I took such pains to cow them. Even pirates have their pride, I suppose. Enough to march to their deaths, no less. Oh, the stupidity of it all...

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_001990_YOTSUYU
211.description: It truly is a sickness... I shall just have to lance the boil. Drain them of every last trace of honor and compassion... Every last drop...

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002000_GRYNEWAHT
212.description: My lady, I... I'm going outside!

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002020_GOSETSU
214.description: The kami are not finished with you yet...

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002030_LYSE
215.description: There's no end to them! They just keep coming!

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002040_ALISAIE
216.description: Then we must be doing something right. We have to hold out for as long as we can. <hex:020810E905FF065368652773FF054865277303> counting on us!

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002050_KOJINSOLDIER
217.description: S-Susano is slain! Slain by the shell-less one!

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002060_LYSE
218.description: Is it true? Did you defeat him?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002070_LYSE
219.description: Well, in that case─how do you fancy helping us keep the Kojin occupied until the Confederacy make their move?

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002080_LYSE
220.description: Speak of the devils─that's coming from Isari!

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002090_ALISAIE
221.description: I think we've done all we can here. Let's withdraw and make for the village.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002100_LYSE
222.description: Right! Although...they don't seem keen to let us go...

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002110_ALISAIE
223.description: Hear me, Kojin of the Red!<hex:02100103>We have no quarrel with you─only your imperial masters!

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002120_ALISAIE
224.description: No more blood need be shed this day! I pray you let us go in peace!

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002130_KOUJINTAICHO
225.description: You dare speak to us of peace!? Your flesh will feed the fishes, thief! Attaaack!

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002140_LYSE
226.description: Now's our chance! Don't worry about her─she can handle herself!

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002150_ALISAIE
227.description: I can't let you take all the glory, can I?

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002160_TANSUI
228.description: My Eorzean friends! Saw the smoke, did you? A pity you did not come sooner─though I gather you were busy elsewhere.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002170_LYSE
229.description: Gosetsu! You're alive! You're all alive...

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002180_GOSETSU
230.description: And full of vim and vigor, hah hah hah!<hex:02100103>Did I not tell you I was no stranger to chains?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002190_ALISAIE
231.description: The fighting cannot have lasted long. Where are all the imperials?

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002200_RASHO
232.description: Fled. They stood their ground for a time─until it became clear that their Kojin reinforcements would not be coming.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002210_RASHO
233.description: We took some few casualties, but my deeper regret is having let Yotsuyu slip through my fingers. That bodyguard of hers may be a half-wit, but he's a mean bastard on the battlefield.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002220_TANSUI
234.description: In any event, I imagine all involved are satisfied with this outcome. So far as the Empire is concerned, the Confederacy attacked Isari in retaliation for the viceroy's actions─and without the aid of insurrectionists, I might add.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002230_TANSUI
235.description: Suffice it to say, we are prepared to be the subject of their undivided attention for the foreseeable future.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
237.description: Doma shall be free. This we swear.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002240_RASHO
240.description: Hm! An impossible claim, yet one spoken with such conviction that I cannot choose but believe it.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002250_RASHO
241.description: Nor you. Our fates are intertwined now. If you fall, so do we.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002260_RASHO
242.description: I understand. You have your doubts. We are pirates, after all, with hardly the strength of a nation.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002270_RASHO
243.description: But when we saw what you few had accomplished, our hearts could not choose but stir in our breasts.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002280_ALISAIE
244.description: Your assistance would be most welcome. Nevertheless, we shall do our utmost to spare you undue danger─we are already in your debt.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002290_TANSUI
245.description: Nay, little miss, all debts are paid. For by your deeds, many still live who elsewise would not. Let both parties count their blessings, and may fortune continue to favor us all.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002300_RASHO
246.description: You still seek to bring freedom to our people, then? You will go to Yanxia?

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002310_GOSETSU
247.description: I have faith that our allies yet live.<hex:02100103>Once we have found them, we will plan our next step.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002320_RASHO
248.description: Yanxia was the crucible of the rebellion. What happened here pales in comparison to what Yotsuyu did there.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002330_RASHO
249.description: Remember this: fear changes men. Have care in whom you place your trust.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002340_TANSUI
250.description: And with that, we must take our wounded home. Oh! Your shellback friend sends his regards, and looks forward to your next meeting. Try not to die before then, eh?

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002349_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
251.description: Meanwhile, on the shores of Othard...

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002350_KOUJINTAICHO
252.description: We cannot rest here for long. This place is not safe...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002360_KOUJINTAICHO
253.description: ...Mayhap nowhere is, if thieves can breach our vaults. Nevertheless, it is our duty to protect these treasures, and we shall not fail for want of effort.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002370_YOTSUYU
254.description: So this is why you abandoned your posts─and without a word of explanation at that. Rather thoughtless of you, was it not?

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002380_KOUJINTAICHO
255.description: Lady Yotsuyu! Pray forgive us our absence, but our home was under attack─our vaults plundered by outsiders!

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002390_YOTSUYU
256.description: Did you even pause to consider the possibility that it might be a diversion? What is the point of contracting your services if you are not here when they are required?

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002400_YOTSUYU
257.description: It is my solemn charge to bring these vermin to heel─to torment them, body and soul, until all they hold dear is as bitter ashes in their mouths. And then you go and ruin everything!

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002410_YOTSUYU
258.description: ...Well, there's naught to be gained in belaboring the point.<hex:02100103>All that remains is to administer your punishment.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002430_YOTSUYU
260.description: No...no, it's no good. There's just no joy in it. No release.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002440_YOTSUYU
261.description: There...there needs to be some investment. They were negligent imbeciles deserving of punishment, but it was hardly personal. Ten thousand such Kojin could not satisfy me half so well as a single Doman.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002450_YOTSUYU
262.description: And what do we have here? One of the vaunted treasures of the Red?<hex:02100103>The craftsmanship is certainly impressive...<hex:02100103>Mayhap we can use it to make amends.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002460_GRYNEWAHT
263.description: How long before Lord Zenos reinstates me, d'you reckon? I've got unfinished business back in Eorzea...

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002470_YOTSUYU
264.description: Is serving me really so unbearable?<hex:02100103>At least pretend to enjoy it, you witless lump!

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002480_YOTSUYU
265.description: If you are so desperate to earn a way back to Eorzea, then be quiet and do as you're told. And bring that sword while you're at it!

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002490_LYSENARRATION
266.description: I remember the silence. How the talking stopped when we first set foot on the plains of Yanxia.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002500_LYSENARRATION
267.description: Before us stood yet another wall, and through a great magitek field we glimpsed Doma Castle.<hex:02100103>I'll never forget the sight...or the anger I felt that day.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002510_LYSENARRATION
268.description: Life. Liberty. Hope. So much lost, so much taken.<hex:02100103>As we walked through that war-torn land, no one said a word...

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002520_ALISAIE
269.description: We may be in luck. I don't see a single imperial soldier.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002530_GOSETSU
270.description: Then there is no need to remain hidden. Let us go and greet them as friends.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002550_GOSETSU
272.description: Good people of Namai, hearken to me! We come in peace and desire only information─to learn of recent events!

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002570_E3F2VILLAGERB
274.description: Lord Gosetsu!? Kami preserve, you're right! He lives!

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002580_GOSETSU
275.description: I say, brothers and sisters, is aught amiss? Why do you regard me as one would a wild beast? Why is there fear in your eyes? Why do you tremble so?

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002590_GOSETSU
276.description: Ahhh, but of course! You fear me a vengeful spirit of the dead! Rest assured, naught could be further from the truth. For am I not corporeal? Are my feet not firmly set upon the ground? Hah hah!

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002600_E3F2VILLAGERA
277.description: What should we do? If they catch him here, you know what will happen...

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002610_E3F2VILLAGERB
278.description: Of all the times for him to turn up─ Has the old fool lost his mind?

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002620_ISSE
279.description: (-Flustered Youth-)You! But... Why have you come here? What do you want from us?

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002630_GOSETSU
280.description: I know not who you are to speak thus to your elders, boy, but mine only desire is to be received with the hospitality owed a humble traveler─not the fear and trepidation one might afford a wrathful shade!

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002640_ISSE
281.description: (-Flustered Youth-)What? What are you going on about? Actually, never mind.<hex:02100103>Just come with me─now!

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002650_LYSE
282.description: This is the House of the Fierce? But there are so few of them...

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002660_GOSETSU
283.description: Many kindred spirits remain in hiding following the rebellion. Many others gave their lives for their nation. We are the stubborn remainder.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002670_GOSETSU
284.description: Even accounting for our comrades in the field, we are at a fraction of our former strength, 'tis true. Yet we few are patriots─brothers-in-arms, prepared to fight with every fiber of our being to set our people free.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002680_YUGIRI
285.description: Ever are we hopeful that others will join our cause. But never did I dream that you would journey so far.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002690_LYSE
286.description: Yugiri! Gods, it's good to see you! You look great, by the way!<hex:02100103>Have you been here long?

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002700_YUGIRI
287.description: I returned but recently, having concluded my mission.<hex:02100103>Oh, it is good to see you again, my friends.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002710_GOSETSU
288.description: Did I hear aright? Your mission is concluded?<hex:02100103>Then you have found the young master?

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002720_YUGIRI
289.description: Ere we speak of that, I would know by what fortuitous circumstance our friends came to be here.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002730_YUGIRI
290.description: The Empire's crimes are all too familiar. Lyse─my heart goes out to your people.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002740_LYSE
291.description: We wanted to stay and fight, believe me, but we knew it wouldn't work.<hex:02100103>We needed more time to rebuild─and more allies to stand with us against<hex:02100103>the Empire.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002750_LYSE
292.description: So we decided to come here and help you free Doma. To show you─to show everyone─that you're not alone, and that the Garleans can be beaten, if we work together. I'd like to think we proved that in the Ruby Sea...

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002760_YUGIRI
293.description: That you did, Lyse, and far more besides. Needless to say, your assistance would be most welcome.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002770_GOSETSU
294.description: Hear, hear! Now then, Yugiri─you must tell me of your search for our master!

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002780_YUGIRI
295.description: Lest you wonder, he speaks of Lord Hien, son of Lord Kaien, who perished during the rebellion.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002790_YUGIRI
296.description: When it became clear that all hope of victory had gone, Lord Hien bade us deliver as many of our people as we could to safety beyond our borders. But as his father's heir, he was determined to fight on, and so he did─until he suffered a grievous wound in battle and vanished without a trace...

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002800_YUGIRI
297.description: Until now. For I have found Lord Hien─seen and spoken with him.<hex:02100103>On the Azim Steppe.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002810_GOSETSU
298.description: O boundless and merciful kami, the young master lives!<hex:02100103>Tell me, was he well? Did his wound yet ail him? Where is he now?<hex:02100103>Have you brought him back to us!?

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002820_YUGIRI
299.description: You may take comfort in the knowledge that he is hale and whole. However, when I invited him to return with me to Doma, he had this to say...

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002830_YUGIRI
300.description: "If Doma yet thirsts for the blood of patriots and tyrants, I shall offer unto her my blade. But if she has had her fill of bitter draughts, I shall offer unto her conquerors my head.“

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002840_YUGIRI
301.description: Thrice did I declare to him that no true son or daughter of Doma would ever accept such a sacrifice. But for all my passion, he would not be swayed.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002850_YUGIRI
302.description: "Learn the truth of her heart and return to me,“ he said. And so I left him.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002860_GOSETSU
303.description: The words of one made to wear the mantle of leadership too soon...

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002870_GOSETSU
304.description: Yet there is wisdom in them all the same. If the people no longer yearn to be free, 'twould be folly to rekindle the fires of war.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002880_YUGIRI
305.description: To suffer our master to surrender his life and forsake all hope of freedom is by far the greater folly. I will not go to face my fallen comrades having done naught to stop it.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002890_GOSETSU
306.description: Nor I, shadow walker, nor I. But we need not rouse our comrades to battle<hex:02100103>this day. Let us instead welcome our honored guests and allow them a<hex:02100103>moment of respite.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002910_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
308.description: Why are you milling about like a pack of slack-jawed mongrels!?<hex:02100103>Form a line! Now!

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002920_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
309.description: ...Finally. I come before you today to deliver an announcement of the highest import, so listen well.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002930_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
310.description: While on a charitable mission to Isari village, the acting viceroy and her personal guard came under attack from Confederate forces. This brazen, unconscionable act cannot─and will not─go unanswered.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002940_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
311.description: As loyal subjects of the Empire who enjoy her safety and prosperity, you have a duty to defend her as well.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002950_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
312.description: ...There is no cause for alarm. We have no intention of sending ill-trained fodder to the front line.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002960_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
313.description: Those who are selected will be expected to perform rudimentary tasks. Cleaning and maintenance and so forth. You will serve only as long as you are needed. Afterwards, you will be free to return to your homes.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002980_YUGIRI
315.description: Hmph. The Empire has no pressing need of cleaners. This is but a thinly veiled attempt to intimidate those who supported the Confederacy's actions, and isolate any whose loyalty they already suspect.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_002990_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
316.description: And lastly...you. That should suffice for now.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003000_ISSE
317.description: Don't worry, I will be back before you know it. Listen to the elders while I am away, and do not play outside the village. Everything is going to be fine. I love you, all right? Remember that I love you...

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003010_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
318.description: We thank you for your cooperation. Rest assured that this will all be over very soon─once the Confederacy has been made to pay our own “Ruby Tithe.”

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003020_LYSE
319.description: There's no telling what might happen to those people! We have to help them!

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003030_YUGIRI
320.description: And we shall. But before all else, we must needs ascertain their destination.<hex:02100103>I doubt this is the first village the Garleans have visited...nor is it like to<hex:02100103>be the last.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003040_YUGIRI
321.description: I will track these men. Will you help me?

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003050_YUGIRI
322.description: Pray return to our headquarters and tell the others what you saw here.<hex:02100103>Should we have need of reinforcements, I would know that they are ready.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003060_LYSE
323.description: But I should be going with you! I came here to fight!

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003070_YUGIRI
324.description: Soon enough, Lyse. Soon enough. For now, we must proceed with caution.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003080_LYSE
325.description: I know that, I do... It's just─when I saw them rounding those people up... Look, if anything happens─anything at all─you'd better call for us! I mean it, Yugiri. Anything at all.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003090_YUGIRI
326.description: Listen to me, all of you! We have dealt with the imperials for now, but you must flee this place, quickly!

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003100_E3F2VILLAGERD
327.description: D-Dealt with them? Oh...oh no...you didn't kill them, did you?

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003110_E3F2VILLAGERA
328.description: Are you mad!? There's no escaping the Empire!<hex:02100103>Running will only make it worse!

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003120_YUGIRI
329.description: To stay is to die. You know this to be true.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003130_YUGIRI
330.description: Even if you lack the will to fight, surely you have the will to live! Or has that, too, been beaten out of you? Is this what has become of Doma!?

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003140_ISSE
331.description: You are Lord Hien's retainer?<hex:02100103>Trained to fight without fear and obey without question?

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003150_ISSE
332.description: Well, we're not! We're lost and afraid! We hate this─all of this─but we can't do a damn thing to change it! And trying will only make it worse.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003160_ISSE
333.description: It's a pathetic existence...but it's all we've got. And when people like you come here pretending it can be different, it─ It doesn't help, all right!?

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003170_WOUNDEDOLDMAN
334.description: Peace, boy. Peace. She came to help, and for that we should be grateful.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003190_WOUNDEDOLDMAN
336.description: We all have scars. Some too many to bear.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003200_WOUNDEDOLDMAN
337.description: Too many battles, too much lost. Our friends, our family, even our liege.<hex:02100103>We who survived are forced to bend the knee─to sell our souls and<hex:02100103>surrender our dignity.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003210_WOUNDEDOLDMAN
338.description: How are we to lift our heads when this shame weighs so heavily upon us? Your courage, your resolve... They are as salt in our wounds.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003220_YUGIRI
339.description: If they only knew what you would do for them, my lord...

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003230_YUGIRI
340.description: You have made your plight clear, and I shall impose my will no more.<hex:02100103>But know this, brothers and sisters of Doma.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003240_YUGIRI
341.description: For all you have suffered─for all the horror and the ignominy─you are still here. You are still alive.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003250_YUGIRI
342.description: My lord─ My lord prays you value your life as highly as he does. As for me...I swear by all the kami in creation that I will free you from this torment.<hex:02100103>No matter the cost.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003260_E3F2VILLAGERD
343.description: ...If the imperials come for me, I will tell them we were tricked by an Auri woman.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003270_YUGIRI
344.description: Tell them whatever you must to keep your loved ones safe.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003290_YUGIRI
346.description: Forgive me for making you search.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003300_YUGIRI
347.description: It calms me, the sound.<hex:02100103>It helps me to remember the sway of the ocean when I close my eyes...

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003310_YUGIRI
348.description: Despite the many great and noble things I said, in truth I am not of Doma.<hex:02100103>I was born beneath the waves of the Ruby Sea...

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003320_YUGIRI
349.description: To think that you were there─that you even spoke with my mother and father...

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003330_YUGIRI
350.description: They are in good health, then. The knowledge is...of great comfort to me.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003340_YUGIRI
351.description: That I might have the strength to protect my home from the Empire, I left to learn the secrets of the shinobi. Day and night we trained, ever striving to exceed our mental and physical limits.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003350_YUGIRI
352.description: After a time, my skills were recognized, and I was dispatched to assist the Doman Liberation Front. It was then that I met Lord Kaien and his son, and their loyal samurai, Gosetsu.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003360_YUGIRI
353.description: Good men, all. Brave and true, so clear their eyes, so pure their purpose. Any shinobi would have been proud to serve them and Doma.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003370_YUGIRI
354.description: ...But, in the end, I will always be of the sea.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003380_YUGIRI
355.description: Every day, I pray for my home, and for the people I left behind.<hex:02100103>That they might be spared the wages of war, and live in peace, untouched by this madness.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003390_YUGIRI
356.description: I confessed this to Lord Hien once. Do you know what he said to me?

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003400_YUGIRI
357.description: He said: “Good. We are better for the conviction of our allies, and draw inspiration from their example. What is weak alone may together grow stronger.”

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003410_YUGIRI
358.description: Never did I lose faith in them. Even when all was lost, and I led our people to Eorzea, I clung to the belief that our dream would one day be realized.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003420_YUGIRI
359.description: But when I gazed into those eyes bereft of hope─when those broken men balked at liberty, the dream was shattered.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
361.description: Together we are strong, and we must carry on.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
362.description: It will not always be so.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003430_YUGIRI
364.description: That you remain resolute, even in the face of everything we have seen... It heartens me more than you know. Thank you for standing by this naive fool.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003440_YUGIRI
365.description: So I pray... And thus do I labor to see a new day dawn, regardless of my misgivings. When all is said and done, we can but carry on─together.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003450_YUGIRI
366.description: Forgive me! We shinobi are taught to discharge our duties without hesitation or doubt. Come what may, I shall not falter.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003470_YUGIRI
368.description: It is bound for Doma Castle. Quickly, we must rejoin the others!

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003480_LYSE
369.description: There you are! What happened? Are the villagers all right?

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003490_YUGIRI
370.description: W-We freed them, along with many others.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003500_YUGIRI
371.description: Gosetsu─we spied an airship bound for the castle. Know you aught of it?

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003510_GOSETSU
372.description: Aye, that we do... The crown prince is come to Doma.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003520_ALISAIE
373.description: We suspect this is the result of recent events in Gyr Abania. Our defeat notwithstanding, there appears to be some concern in Garlemald that subversive elements may be rallying in other provinces.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003530_ALISAIE
374.description: Though Yotsuyu governs Doma, Zenos remains the province's anointed viceroy─and it would seem he has come to assess the current situation<hex:02100103>in person.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003540_YUGIRI
375.description: If Zenos is here, we must seize this opportunity and kill him.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003550_ALISAIE
376.description: Would that it were so simple, Lady Yugiri. You may recall that we encountered Zenos at Rhalgr's Reach. We have seen firsthand what he can do. His power defies explanation.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003560_ALISAIE
377.description: He faced the Alliance, the Resistance and the Scions, and he defeated us all.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003570_ALISAIE
378.description: We survived and learned from the experience, it is true─but if we are to defeat him, it will not be through simple opportunism. We will require a flawless plan.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003580_YUGIRI
379.description: We know his strengths. A prodigious swordsman trained from childhood by the finest imperial tutors, reputed to be without equal on the battlefield. Which is why we must not meet him there.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003590_YUGIRI
380.description: Nay, we keep to the shadows─the domain of the shinobi. And thence we strike. You need only give me the chance.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003600_GOSETSU
381.description: Were this but a matter of personal revenge, I would not presume to bar your path, for I myself crave that same vengeance.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003610_GOSETSU
382.description: But to draw steel against the Emperor's son is a grave decision, and one that will shape our nation's future. Do not forget Lord Hien's words!

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003620_YUGIRI
383.description: What, that we should sheathe our swords if the people lack the will to fight!? I will not squander this opportunity! If we do naught, our master's life is forfeit!

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003630_GOSETSU
384.description: Even should you succeed, Zenos's death will not win Doma her freedom─more likely her doom.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003640_GOSETSU
385.description: Can we defend our people against the Empire's retribution? We few against a legion? Do not be a fool, child!

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003650_YUGIRI
386.description: ...Mayhap I am a fool with foolish dreams of a future that will never be.<hex:02100103>But I cannot─I will not forsake them!

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003690_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
390.description: The village is not far, my lord.<hex:02100103>If it please you, we shall escort you there directly.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003700_ZENOS
391.description: Hmph. Less a province than a graveyard. The rotting husk of a broken nation, devoid of proper sport. <sigh> But as His Radiance wishes...

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003710_GARLEANLEADERDOMA
392.description: Y-Yes, of course, my lord! A-And may I say how terribly sorry we are that you had to come so far!

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003720_ZENOS
393.description: We labored long to sow the seeds of hatred, of fear─to train them as beasts. Now we shall see the harvest.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003730_ZENOS
394.description: Let there be savage beasts baying for blood, and not hollow-eyed prey cowering in the dark, or there will be no joy in this hunt.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003750_YOTSUYU
396.description: Shinobi!? And me without my brute...

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003760_ZENOS
397.description: How weak you are. Is this the sum of your hate?

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003770_YUGIRI
398.description: This is only the beginning! For Lord Kaien! For Doma!

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003790_ZENOS
400.description: Mayhap I shall test this new blade of yours. Let us hope it is to my liking,<hex:02100103>lest your misfortunes compound.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003800_ZENOS
401.description: Then again, I am loath to expend such effort on the unworthy.<hex:02100103>Come─earn the honor.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003810_ZENOS
402.description: Ahhh...I remember you. Ala Mhigo. The champion of the savages.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003820_URIANGER
403.description: "Look ye where the sun doth rise, see crimson embers, dark'ning skies...

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003830_URIANGER
404.description: "Look ye where the sun doth fall, see azure lost amidst the squall.“

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003840_ZENOS
405.description: Oh...how right I was to spare your life.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003850_ZENOS
406.description: Hear me, hero. Endure. Survive. Live.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003860_ZENOS
407.description: For the rush of blood, for the time between the seconds─live.<hex:02100103>For the sole pleasure left to me in this empty, ephemeral world─live!

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003890_ISSE
410.description: Get away from them, you imperial dog!

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003900_YUGIRI
411.description: No, don't... You must...you must flee!

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003910_ISSE
412.description: We're not going anywhere! Do you hear me!? We're not running away!

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003920_ISSE
413.description: What you're doing is stupid and reckless and I never wanted any part of it,<hex:02100103>but here we are!

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003930_ISSE
414.description: I've spent my whole life hating myself─for every time they made me beg,<hex:02100103>for every time I held my tongue to protect the people I love.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003940_ISSE
415.description: And then you came along and reminded me of all the things I never said and never did, and it was even worse! I would have given anything to forget, to walk away, but I knew that I'd never be able to live with the guilt.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003950_ISSE
416.description: So we came─all of us! For you, for ourselves─for Doma!

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003960_ZENOS
417.description: Death is death, regardless of the reason.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_003970_ZENOS
418.description: Yet you seem determined to die, intruding upon this sacred ground, turning weapons you can scarcely wield upon me. Your lives will not even begin to redress the balance.

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004010_YOTSUYU
422.description: <cough> <cough> I can't see a damn thing... Someone stop them!

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004030_E3F2VILLAGERC
424.description: How are you feeling, my lady?

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004040_YUGIRI
425.description: Much the better for my comrades' ministrations, and your most generous hospitality. You need not worry.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004050_E3F2VILLAGERC
426.description: Good... If there is anything else we can do for the two of you─anything at all─just ask.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004060_GOSETSU
427.description: Stare any harder and you're like to burn a hole in them.<hex:02100103>Go and say your piece for goodness' sake!

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004070_ISSE
428.description: I've got nothing more to say to them!<hex:02100103>I'm going to find out how the others are getting on.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004080_YUGIRI
429.description: Gosetsu, Mistress Alisaie─I owe you an apology.<hex:02100103>I acted with reckless disregard for my own safety, and endangered I know not how many others in so doing.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004090_YUGIRI
430.description: Scorning your wise counsel, I knowingly defied our master's wishes, and left you no choice but to follow suit.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004100_GOSETSU
431.description: Nonsense. I followed our master's wishes to the letter. Consider once more his words, and the intent therein.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004110_GOSETSU
432.description: In offering his head, he but sought to shield his people from harm─loyal retainers included. You must value your life more highly, shadow walker.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004120_ALISAIE
433.description: On the other hand, your recklessness did serve as an inspiration to many. Mayhap you should not be so hard on yourself...

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004130_ALISAIE
434.description: In any event, if you must apologize profusely, it seems only right that you expend as much effort thanking the one person who supported your plan from the first.

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004140_YUGIRI
435.description: That it does. There are no words which will suffice...but thank you.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004160_ALPHINAUD
437.description: Twelve be praised! When I learned of your rather questionable plot to assassinate Zenos, I feared we would need to recruit a new primal slayer.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004170_LYSE
438.description: I'm sorry we couldn't be there.<hex:02100103>Alisaie made me swear to stay behind no matter what.

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004180_LYSE
439.description: I think she was worried I'd hurl myself at Zenos the moment I set eyes on him.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004200_ALISAIE
441.description: You'll forgive me for changing the subject, but now would seem a good time to discuss where we go from here. Though the Empire has yet to retaliate, the fact remains that we have revealed our presence, and signaled our intentions in so doing. It is only a matter of time before the imperials move against us.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004210_ALISAIE
442.description: Given that we lack the strength to oppose them, 'tis plain some manner of brilliant stratagem is required. Therefore, I yield the floor to the preeminent tactician of our time, with whom I was privileged to share a womb.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004220_ALPHINAUD
443.description: If you insist... While in Kugane we debated a number of approaches and were eventually forced to concede that we cannot look to the Alliance for aid.

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004230_ALPHINAUD
444.description: Even were it possible to ferry sufficient forces and materiel from Eorzea in a timely manner, such a massive undertaking would not long escape the attention of the Empire. 'Twould be a miracle if our ships reached the shore.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004240_ALPHINAUD
445.description: Fortunately, according to Tataru and Hancock's intelligence, the Empire has withdrawn most of its forces from Doma in the past year, leaving her relatively unguarded.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004250_ALPHINAUD
446.description: That being the case, a popular uprising spearheaded by the full might of the Doman Liberation Front may feasibly be sufficient to threaten the seat of provincial government, namely Doma Castle. 'Twould be rather easier said than done, of course, but I have seen worse plans prevail.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004260_GOSETSU
447.description: Then we must needs meet with Lord Hien and convince him to return, for there is no surer way to inspire our people to rise up as one.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004270_GOSETSU
448.description: He desired proof of his subjects' conviction, and they have provided it─through no less a deed than openly opposing Zenos himself!

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004280_LYSE
449.description: It will work. It has to work. And next time, we will defeat him...

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004289_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
450.description: Meanwhile, in the keep of Doma Castle...

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004290_ZENOS
451.description: ...I would expect no less of Bahamut's conqueror.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004300_ZENOS
452.description: Prepare the airship. His Radiance will not object; we have fulfilled our obligations here. I would see this prize for myself...

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004320_ZENOS
454.description: Do you understand why I appointed you to act in my stead? You, whose only accomplishment was to whisper the right words in the right ear?

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004330_ZENOS
455.description: Because of your petty hatreds.<hex:02100103>They render you the perfect instrument to bleed your kinsmen of hope─<hex:02100103>to make an example of Doma, such as was ordered.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004360_ZENOS
458.description: If you yield Doma to the rebels, you will not be given another chance to beg forgiveness.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004370_ZENOS
459.description: Do your duty. Now. Or die with the rest of them.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004380_GRYNEWAHT
460.description: A-Are you all right, my lady? That was uncalled for...

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004400_YOTSUYU
462.description: They say your Eorzean is helping the rebels.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004410_YOTSUYU
463.description: I want <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> dead. I want <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> friends dead. I want the heads of everyone <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> knows and loves mounted on the castle walls!

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004420_GRYNEWAHT
464.description: You mean...you mean I can finally go after <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>?

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004430_GRYNEWAHT
465.description: Bwahahahaha! I've been waiting for this chance! I promise you, my lady─<hex:02100103><hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> won't escape this time! Not this time, oh no!

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004439_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
466.description: Meanwhile, in the fringes of Gyr Abania...

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004450_ESTINIEN
468.description: (-???-)...When his shade was banished, you swore to leave this life behind.<hex:02100103>And yet here you are...

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004460_ESTINIEN
469.description: Yet if this be the work of the Eyes, what choice do you have but to end it? <sigh> Or so the boy would say. Damn you, Alphinaud.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004470_LYSENARRATION
470.description: I remember the emptiness. Vast and endless.<hex:02100103>The Azim Steppe, home to countless roaming tribes.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004480_LYSENARRATION
471.description: A sacred land watched over by elder gods. Here we would find Doma's salvation.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04002_004490_LYSENARRATION
472.description: With the wind at our backs we walked on. In search of hope. In search of him.
